stage: bounded source-only scale diagnostic after v1; no target rollout
motivation: v1 near-constant contexts above the 1e-8 fallback threshold create standardized query values above one million and dominate the NLL used for training and early stopping

change.reference_variance: median of within-task unbiased response variances, using only the 262 source-training tasks, separately per space; fail if this median is nonpositive or nonfinite
change.normalization_mean: mean of current context responses only
change.limit: this supplies a non-neural offline scale prior; a later pure-online comparison must retain an explicit online-GP-plus-this-scale control

fixed_design.spaces: all 15 from v1, no result-dependent selection
fixed_design.network_and_base: same v1 initialization, architecture, optimizer, base constraints and PCA cache
fixed_design.episodes: same step-indexed v1 episodes and fixed validation panels; reuse source-only v1 O prefixes
fixed_design.selection: minimum fixed source-validation conditional NLL including step zero
fixed_design.comparison: all matching v1 seed-0 fits; disclose single seed as a diagnostic, not replication

report.aggregation: average episodes/tasks within each raw validation dataset group, then equally average the eight groups
report.across_versions: compare choice regret and coverage directly; compare density scores in raw response units: NLL_raw = NLL_standardized + log(scale). Standardized NLLs from different scale policies are not directly comparable
report.interpretation: source validation was used for selection; no statistical-confirmation or real target-evaluation-efficiency claim

resources.placement: numeric-space-order indices divisible by 8 use CUDA, all other spaces CPU; keep all three paired methods of a space on one device; identities record placement before fitting

numerical_audit: replay on the training device at the original absolute metric tolerance 1e-7; preserve and separately describe any CPU/GPU differences; do not change the failed v1 CPU check
stop: stop after these 45 fits and their report; no automatic architecture/epoch/scale search, seed expansion, target queries, confirmation access or final claim
